solutions.title: Linear boundary scan
solutions.strategy: Scan the array and record the first and last matching positions.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every value may be inspected when the target appears late or is absent.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two index variables are maintained.

solutions.title: Lower and upper-bound searches
solutions.strategy: Find the first index not less than target and the first index greater than target without relying on target arithmetic.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each lower-bound search halves the range, and two such searches are run.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The search uses a constant number of counters.
